title: Camera on Table
summary: A black camera body rests on a light wooden table.

parts.name: camera
parts.role: rests in static equilibrium on surface

how_it_works.text: Gravity pulls the camera downward toward the ground.
The stiff tabletop pushes upward with a normal force.
Friction at the contact resists any sideways sliding.
Balanced forces leave the camera at rest in equilibrium.
